promptEs: Escuchá el acorde y elegí su calidad.
promptEn: Listen to the chord and choose its quality.
explanationEs: Fa-La es tercera mayor y Fa-Do quinta justa: es un Fa mayor. La tercera luminosa y la quinta estable lo distinguen de la tríada menor y de las inestables.
explanationEn: F-A is a major third and F-C a perfect fifth: it is an F major triad. The bright third and stable fifth distinguish it from the minor triad and from the unstable ones.
